title: Dating time
source_topic: ICPC / The 2019 Asia Danang Regional Contest
statement: Given a start time, an end time and an angle that is zero, ninety or a hundred and eighty degrees, the task is to count the instants in the closed interval at which the hour and minute hands of a continuously moving analogue clock form exactly that angle. Both times fall within one day, and up to one hundred such queries are asked.
